lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and sign_in (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome.
Predictions were consistently too high across tests.

candidates.title: Two Column Adoption Certificate Creator
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a side-by-side two-column layout showing dynamic pet naming on the left and certificate preview on the right.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest friction in the funnel with only 60.9% conversion and a median time of 89s.

adoption_certificate.headline: Design Your Pet's Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your desktop pet a official name and claim your adoption record.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining its core function is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%), but redesign cost is high and past lift was small (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Sheet
candidates.change: Appends a dedicated new screen after home intro showing essential keyboard shortcuts and tray control actions for desktop management.
candidates.why: Support logs show multiple tickets regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after setup.

new_shortcuts_sheet.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
new_shortcuts_sheet.body: Quick reference guide to control, interact with, or minimize your new desktop friend.

components.label: Click pet to open chat window
Right-click pet for instant actions & settings
Use System Tray to hide or summon pet anytime

guard.reason: 'new_shortcuts_sheet.components[1].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Post Adoption Sign In Placement
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation instead of right after choose path.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently sits before users pick their pet (72.9% conversion), creating early drop-off before emotional investment in a specific companion.

guard.reason: Moving the sign-in step after adoption certificate creation is allowed by onboarding reordering rules.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in builds emotional investment; previous test showed modest +0.8% lift.

candidates.title: Background Pet Preparation Status Stream
candidates.change: Transforms the waiting screen into a dynamic multi-stage preparation flow with live status indicators while the pet generates in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to high drop-offs if users assume the app frozen.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Companion's New Home
waiting.body: Setting up desktop behaviors, animations, and sound effects...

guard.reason: Updating the waiting screen into a dynamic multi-stage preparation flow maintains its job.

candidates.score_note: Home step has long wait, but past home new_flow test yielded severe negative results (-8.2%).

candidates.title: Companion Creation Time Estimate Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear time expectation hint on the path selection screen letting users know setup takes under 2 minutes.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, suggesting users linger or hesitate before committing to a path.

choose_path.hint: Takes under 2 minutes to complete your pet companion creation.

guard.reason: Adding a realistic completion time estimate is permitted and does not violate fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy addition targeting high linger time at choose_path.

candidates.title: Background Hatching Desktop Notification Prompt
candidates.change: Adds an explicit desktop notification opt-in toggle on the waiting screen so users can safely switch windows while waiting.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes over 3 minutes median time, causing users to minimize or forget the desktop application.

waiting.headline: We'll Notify You When Ready
waiting.hint: Feel free to use other apps. We will send a quick desktop notification when your pet arrives.

guard.reason: Adding a desktop notification opt-in prompt on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Helps prevent drop-off during long 201s median wait by enabling background notifications.

candidates.title: Cloud Sync Account Preservation Copy
candidates.change: Updates the sign-in screen messaging to clearly explain that signing in saves and syncs pet progress to cloud storage.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with different credentials.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in with your primary account to ensure your pet progress and settings are safely synced and recoverable.
sign_in.hint: Using the same login keeps your pet consistent across all your desktop devices.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain cloud sync benefits is allowed and does not mention pricing.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel drop-off and 8 support emails confirm sign-in confusion; cheap copy fix.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Badge
candidates.change: Adds an animated official adoption seal badge upon completing pet naming on the certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep 39.1% drop-off; adding a visual reward accentuates accomplishment.

guard.reason: Adding an official adoption seal badge on the certificate screen complies with base rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest friction step (adoption 60.9%) with visual reward incentive.

candidates.title: Pet Hatching Progress Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Adds an automatic rotating tip carousel explaining pet personalities and desktop interaction tips while waiting.
candidates.why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s; engaging content during the wait reduces drop-off and prepares users for desktop controls.

guard.reason: Adding a rotating tip carousel during the wait screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) by entertaining users during setup.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Companion Story Intro
candidates.change: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into an immersive full-bleed mascot visual showcasing companion interactions.
candidates.why: The choose_path initial step has a mean duration of 514s; a strong emotional hook improves early conversion.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Adopt an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop display, reacts to your daily workflow, and keeps you company.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen visual layout while keeping pet introduction is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High effort visual overhaul on step with relatively good conversion (76.2%).

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign) and home (new_flow) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome (+7.8% vs -6.3%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful, with both tests agreeing on positive noise-corrected results and one test winning (+8.1%).
Predictions were usually too high across most tests, but was too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.
